title: THE REAL REASON IRAN WAS ATTACKED

sense.text:
“Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia”: Cyrus is king of Persia, and here we are reading about the Persians. To know who Iran is today, and why Iran was attacked, you have to know who the Persians are.

Persia officially changed its name to Iran on March 21st, 1935, when Reza Pahlavi asked foreign diplomats to use the native name Iran instead of Persia. So when we read about Cyrus king of Persia, we are reading about Iran. Let’s call them by their biblical name: the Persians.

“The Lord God of heaven hath given me all the kingdoms of the earth.” God gave Cyrus all the kingdoms of the earth. At one point in time the Persians were ruling the whole earth.

In the image of Daniel 2, the head of gold is Babylon, the breast and arms of silver are the Medes and the Persians, then come the Greeks, then Rome, and America and Europe are an extension of Rome. The Persians ruled before the Greeks.

“Let him go up to Jerusalem, which is in Judah, and build the house of the Lord God of Israel.” Cyrus was instrumental in letting the Israelites go out of slavery. We spent 70 years in Babylon; then under Cyrus and the Persians we were allowed to go back to Jerusalem and rebuild the temple.

That is the people the scriptures call the Persians. Their history in our time explains why they hate America: in 1953 the CIA and MI6 overthrew their democratically elected prime minister, Mosaddegh, after he nationalized the oil, using propaganda, bribed journalists and politicians, and paid street gangs to cause chaos. They set up the Shah, a king who gave Britain and America back control of the oil. The same tactics are being used today by the Mossad and the CIA behind the rioting and civil unrest in Iran.

In 1979 the people rose up, the Ayatollah came back, the Shah fled to America, and they became the Islamic Republic of Iran, a theocracy, meaning God rule. But the God these Persians serve is not the God of the Bible. A year later Saddam Hussein, armed and trained by the CIA, attacked Iran in a war that lasted 8 years with over a million casualties. That is why they say death to America. They are not saying it for no reason.

The Ayatollah they killed, whose name means sign of God or token of God, is the highest ranking cleric of the Shiites, like the pope of the Christians. Killing him will not end it: it will cause things to get worse and escalate. And it is an example for us of how the enemy operates: what they did to them, they will try to do to us.

“And there shall be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation”: that time of trouble is World War III, the third woe.

“And at that time thy people shall be delivered, every one that shall be found written in the book.” At that time the 12 tribes of Israel will be delivered, because we are the ones written in the book of life. You blacks and Hispanics are the true Israelites according to the Bible.

“And I heard, but I understood not.” Daniel heard all that the Lord was showing him and did not understand. “O my Lord, what shall be the end of these things?” When is the end of everything spoken in the verses above: the third woe, destruction, death, nations fighting against each other?

“Go thy way, Daniel: for the words are closed up and sealed till the time of the end.” The time of the end is what we are living in right now, these last days. It is not sealed any more. We can understand it.

“Many shall be purified, and made white, and tried”: you are going to go through trials, tribulation, affliction and Jacob’s trouble, and you brothers that stand strong in this truth are going to get the kingdom and that immortal body. “But the wicked shall do wickedly”: the wicked of our people are going to do wickedly.

“And none of the wicked shall understand.” That is the point. Everybody has an opinion about what is taking place on the earth today, but none of the wicked are going to understand it.

When Trump says America attacked Iran not for now but for the future, so that America is never threatened by a nuclear-armed Iran, somebody understands something. That is the real reason Iran was attacked.

“And in the latter time of their kingdom”: the latter time of their kingdom is the time we are living in right now. “When the transgressors are come to the full”: when the wickedness of America and Europe has come to the full.

“A king of fierce countenance, and understanding dark sentences, shall stand up.” That king is this system here in America, the spiritual wickedness in high places: the higher ups, the Rothschilds, the shadow government that is really ruling. They understand the Bible prophecies to an extent, and what they don’t understand they learn from us, watching and recording online.

They understand that Iran in the future, with Europe, the Arabs and all the sons of Ishmael, will have a role to play in destroying America and Israel. That is why India and Pakistan can have nuclear bombs, but the Persians cannot be allowed intercontinental ballistic missiles or nuclear warheads: when they get them they will use them on us. Many in the legislative branch and the Senate don’t understand it and are confused, saying there was no imminent threat; the people above them do.

Trump ran saying he was about peace and would get into no wars, but Trump doesn’t really make the decisions. There is a 1% that understands what is going to happen in the future, and they gave the order. The real reason Iran was attacked is to stop God’s prophecies; they can’t stop them, so to slow Bible prophecy down.

precepts.why:
This is how they understand the dark sentences: “I will open my mouth in a parable: I will utter dark sayings of old.” The dark sayings of old are the prophecies the prophets wrote, spoken in parables, of what is going to take place in the last days.

That is what the king of Daniel 8:23 understands. When they read the scriptures about the Carmanians raging, they understand it. All the wicked don’t understand it, and our people don’t understand it, but there is a 1% in society, the spiritual wickedness in high places, that does.

sense.text:
“Therefore rejoice, ye heavens, and ye that dwell in them.” The heavens are the people on top, the spiritual wickedness in high places that rule society today: America and Europe. God is saying, rejoice now, have fun, this is your kingdom.

“Woe to the inhabiters of the earth and of the sea!” The inhabiters of the earth are the kings of the earth, the nations that are not on top ruling: Iran, Saudi Arabia, Ethiopia, India, China and all the rest.

“For the devil is come down unto you, having great wrath, because he knoweth that he hath but a short time.” How does Esau, that red dragon, the beast, know his time is short? Because he understands dark sentences. This is not the regular peons; it is the spiritual wickedness in high places. They see the children of Israel waking up throughout the four corners of the earth, and they watch Iran trying to develop nuclear capability, and they say: stop the Persians.

So they come down on the nations with great wrath. Not because they just feel like bombing nations: every move is to buy time and prolong their rulership, to make sure the Arabs don’t come together and Iran never gets nuclear capability, to prevent prophecy from being fulfilled. In his mind he thinks his house will go on forever, yet he knows his time is getting short: I’m going to make sure these Arabs don’t come together, I’m going to make sure Iran never gets nuclear capability, and I’m going to bomb the hell out of them.

And once they finish with these nations, they are coming for us. They will kill a lot of the leaders in IUIC trying to stop us from prophesying and testifying, because we are God’s judges on this earth, and when we testify against them, judgment comes. The laws are already being put in place.

precepts.why:
To prove the heavens are those ruling society: “the Lord shall punish the host of the high ones that are on high.” Those high ones that are on high are the heavens of Revelation 12:12: America and Europe, the fourth beast, the red dragon, ruling the earth today. The Lord will punish them for all the evil they are doing, and in the land of Israel, those Europeans living there that say they are Jews.

“And the kings of the earth upon the earth.” The kings of the earth are Iran, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, India, Pakistan, Ethiopia, Sudan. God is going to punish the high ones on high, and he is also going to punish the kings of the earth. That is the woe unto the inhabiters of the earth.

Another precept to show the heavens are Europe and America: “For my sword shall be bathed in heaven: behold, it shall come down upon Idumea, and upon the people of my curse, to judgment.” This is Christ’s sword. It does not mean his sword is up in the sky; the verse explains who the heaven is.

The sword bathed in heaven comes down upon Idumea, Edom, and Edom today is Europe and America and those Europeans in the land of Israel that call themselves Jews. They are the high ones. “The people of my curse”: God has cursed the white man, the Europeans. That is why they have no pigment in their skin.

So God is going to judge the high ones that are on high, the heavens, and the heavens are Edom. When Revelation says “rejoice, ye heavens”, it is telling them: rejoice now, this is your kingdom.

This explains the inhabiters of the earth, the kings of the earth, the people that are not on top. “He shall flee from the iron weapon, and the bow of steel shall strike him through.” He is America. The iron weapon is the missile, the ballistic missile; the bow of steel is nuclear weapons. “It is drawn, and cometh out of the body; yea, the glittering sword cometh out of his gall”: when those missiles shoot, they look like a glittering sword.

“The heaven shall reveal his iniquity”: that is what you are seeing right now, the Lord revealing the wickedness America is doing on the earth. “And the earth shall rise up against him.”

That is the great wrath of Revelation 12:12: the high ones on high will oppress the nations of the earth, Iran, Saudi Arabia, all nations, even Europe. And because of that oppression all the kings of the earth are going to rise up against America and Israel. What you see now is the beginning, and it is going to get worse. America could end Iran with one of its bombs, but Iran is not going to be fully taken out; there will be no regime change. There will be a truce, the people of Iran will hate America even more, and according to prophecy they will rebuild it all. The powers that be think they are buying time, but the Lord is behind all of it.

This goes back to “woe to the inhabiters of the earth”: because the devil knows he has but a short time, he brings judgment on the nations to control what happens and prolong his time. “That thou shalt take up this proverb against the king of Babylon, and say, How hath the oppressor ceased!” The king of Babylon is America, and America is the oppressor. America will not just oppress us; America will oppress all nations.

“The golden city ceased!” America is the richest country on earth. “The Lord hath broken the staff of the wicked”: the king of Babylon is also called the wicked. “And the sceptre of the rulers”: the rulers are the high ones that are on high.

“He who smote the people in wrath with a continual stroke”: that is what you see going on in Persia right now, and Cuba will be next. They bombed an elementary school and killed over 160 children. And it is not going to stop; what America and Israel are doing will be continual. Iran will humble down for a while and secretly prepare its revenge.

“He that ruled the nations in anger, is persecuted, and none hindereth.” In anger America is going to rule the nations, and nobody hinders it. Nobody cares.

sense.text:
“Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them”: the Medes are the Persian Empire, the joint rulership of the Medes and the Persians. This is Iran. Bible prophecy says God is going to stir up Iran against America and Israel.

Who is the I? The Lord. Who has the Persians chanting death to America right now? The Lord put that spirit in them to fulfill his will. And that 1% ruling society understands this, which is why they will do anything to stop Iran from acquiring intercontinental ballistic missiles and nuclear warheads.

“Which shall not regard silver; and as for gold, they shall not delight in it.” They don’t care about your money. They just killed their Ayatollah, their scientists, their top leaders. They want vengeance, not silver and gold. Right now they are flying a red flag of vengeance in Iran.

“Their bows also shall dash the young men to pieces”: their bows are their missiles. The Persians have the biggest missile capability in the whole Middle East. Saudi Arabia and the other countries buy their weapons from America; Iran makes its own, with technology from Russia and China.

“They shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb; their eye shall not spare children.” When the Persians take vengeance, they won’t care if the woman is pregnant or if it is a six or eight year old child.

The Most High is a mastermind. Ancient Babylon was taken by the Persians and the Medes from within, without great destruction. The same way God used the Persians to destroy ancient Babylon, today God is going to use the Persians to destroy Mystery Babylon the Great. We know NATO and them are going to destroy Babylon, but Persia is going to play a big role in that too. People read about the Persians going up against Babylon and think it is talking about the past, but those higher up in society that understand dark sentences know it is also talking about the future.

“And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beauty of the Chaldees’ excellency, shall be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.” This shows it is not talking about ancient Babylon. Sodom and Gomorrah were destroyed with brimstone and fire; ancient Babylon was not. It is talking about the future. That is a dark sentence, a parable. The wicked will not understand it, but the 1% that gave Trump the order to destroy all of Iran’s nuclear capability understand it to some extent.
“It shall never be inhabited.” That land is still over there today, and it is inhabited. So this is the Babylon of the last days.
“Behold an horrible vision, and the appearance thereof from the east.” The government, the higher ups in society who understand dark sentences, understand this horrible vision.

“Where the nations of the dragons of Arabia shall come out with many chariots”: the dragons of Arabia are all the Arab nations, the sons of Ishmael. They come out to war with many chariots: war machines, tanks and planes. “That all they which hear them may fear and tremble.”

This is Arab unity. All the Arabs will unify in the future and everybody that sees them will fear. That is what to look out for. They are not unified today because many of them are getting rich doing business with America: Egypt lives on billions of dollars of American foreign aid, and Qatar and Dubai are comfortable. But something is going to happen that will cause all the Arabs to unite.

People watch Iran and think Iran is going to start World War III. The Persians are not going to start it. The sons of Ishmael are the ones that are going to pop it off and start the third woe.

“Also the Carmanians raging in wrath”: Carmania was a place in Persia, a warlike people. This is the Persians, Iran. Why are they raging? Because the Ayatollah and all their top leaders were killed, and because of what Israel and America are doing to them. They want vengeance. Things could get crazy in the next 10, 15 or 20 years, but not past 30; we don’t have long on this earth before Christ returns.

“Shall go forth as the wild boars of the wood”: the wild boar was the Persians’ own symbol. In Iranian and Scythian culture the boar appears on gold plaques, weapon fittings and jewelry, standing for ferocity, courage, martial strength, victory and divine guardianship, and associated with their warrior deities. When the prophets wrote “wild boars”, they wrote the Persians’ symbol of bravery and victory.

“And with great power shall they come”: even though their missile factories and nuclear sites are being bombed and destroyed today, they are going to build it back. “And join battle with them”: the Persians will join with the Arabs. Today Iran is already defending the Arabs, since both follow Islam, and says it is the only one fighting for Islam while the Arabs are quiet.

“And shall waste a portion of the land of the Assyrians”: the Persians and the sons of Ishmael are going to waste a portion of the land of Israel, waste it with nuclear bombs. That is why they are trying to keep them divided. Mossad agents were arrested in Qatar and Saudi Arabia planning bombings to blame on Iran, and the missiles that hit the Saudi oil installations and Dubai came from the wrong direction to be Iran’s. Keep the Arabs from uniting with the Carmanians. It is no coincidence the Arabs are divided, and God does not want them to unite yet, because we need to get ourselves together.

precepts.why:
“Arabia, and all the princes of Kedar, they occupied with thee in lambs, and rams, and goats: in these were they thy merchants.” The sons of Ishmael are Babylon’s merchants. They are getting rich from Babylon, all those Arab nations.

That is why the Arabs are not unified yet: they are comfortable, benefiting from Babylon. And this week the Persians attacked most of those Arab nations that have US military bases, hitting every US base and destroying US communications bases all over the Arab countries.

sense.text:
“Also the robbers of thy people”: the robbers of thy people are the Caucasian race. In that time it was the Greeks; today it is the people saying they are Jews and are not, the Caucasians in the land saying they are the people of God.

“Shall exalt themselves to establish the vision”: the Greeks exalted themselves, and the vision was to conquer and take the land of Israel. That is what Antiochus tried to do, and not just take the land: they took the book of the law and painted their likeness and images in it, trying to rob us of our culture. Judas Maccabeus rose up and fought against them. Today they are doing the same thing.

“But they shall fall.” The same way they fell back then is the same way they will fall today. Today the vision is greater Israel: part of Egypt, part of Saudi Arabia, Lebanon, part of Syria, the map IDF soldiers wear on their shoulders. They will try to establish the vision, but they are going to fail.

precepts.why:
“And in the midst of the week he shall cause the sacrifice and the oblation to cease”: that is what Antiochus did. He stopped us from sacrificing and serving God. “And for the overspreading of abominations he shall make it desolate, even until the consummation”: he set up abomination and made our people desolate, meaning he destroyed our people.

So the Greeks, the white man, are called the abomination of desolation, the abomination that maketh desolate. That is the robbers of God’s people in Daniel 11:14.

sense.text: “Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign of thy coming, and of the end of the world?” What signs do we look for to know when Christ is coming back, and to tell when the end of the world is?
“Take heed that no man deceive you.” Don’t let nobody trick you.

“For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ”: these are the people calling themselves Christians and the people calling themselves Jews, Christianity and Judaism. Before Christ returns, the abomination of desolation has to come back and set themselves up as Christians, as anointed ones, and as his people. That is the white man. “And shall deceive many”: everybody on the earth has been deceived into thinking the people in the land are the Jews and these Christians are real Christians.

“And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars”: are we not seeing wars and hearing rumors of wars? “See that ye be not troubled”: Brothers, America just went to war with Iran. Don’t let those things trouble you, because whose side are we on? I don’t care about them Iranis. Bomb the hell out of them. And when Iran gets mad, let them get mad and then they will bomb the hell out of y’all. Let God’s will be done. “For all these things must come to pass, but the end is not yet.” The end is not yet; it might be 10 to 30 years, and as time goes on you will be able to see how soon it is by the events taking place. You got people talking about World War III about to take place. Y’all shut your mouth, man: the wicked shall not understand.
“For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom”: you have the kingdom of Persia fighting the kingdom of the beast, the fourth beast, Mystery Babylon the Great.

“All these are the beginning of sorrows.” We are living in the beginning of sorrows: the babies killed in Palestine, Russia and Ukraine, Pakistan and Afghanistan warring this week, Mystery Babylon warring with the Persians, millions dying in the Congo and Sudan. There is a lot of sorrow coming on this earth, and this is just the beginning.

“When ye therefore shall see the abomination of desolation”: the abomination of desolation is Edom, the Caucasian race. In the time of the Greeks it was the Greeks; in the time of Christ it was the Romans; and Europe is an extension of Rome. Today it is the Europeans in the land calling themselves Jews and are not, the Edomites.

“Stand in the holy place”: in 1949, Europeans from Germany, Poland, Russia and Ukraine went into the holy land and said, we are the people of God. That is the sign: for the end to come, the abomination of desolation has to be in the land. They are called the abomination of desolation because they destroy everything; ask the Palestinians. From the first day they went in the land was the Nakba, and the Palestinians say they will never forget it. But I ain’t feel sorry for you damn Palestinians, or for you Arabs. Islam was forced on our brothers in Africa, and to this day our people are still under Islam. I don’t care about no damn Islam or Muhammad.

“For then shall be great tribulation, such as was not since the beginning of the world to this time, no, nor ever shall be.” That great tribulation is the third woe. The prophecy is twofold: it went into Jerusalem destroyed by the Romans, but Christ is explaining the end, so it also goes into the last days. When the abomination of desolation is in the land, a time of trouble such as never was will come, and they are the ones that are going to instigate it.

“Let favour be shewed to the wicked, yet will he not learn righteousness”: the abomination of desolation is not going to learn righteousness, even though favor is shown to them.

“In the land of uprightness will he deal unjustly”: the land of uprightness is the land of Israel, the holy place. The robbers of God’s people are in the land trying to establish the vision, dealing unjustly with everyone over there, killing and decapitating babies. What they are doing in that land is going to cause all the Arabs to unite against them. When they start killing Egyptians, Saudis and people of Qatar and taking part of Syria, all the Arabs will unite to get rid of the abomination of desolation, and the Persians will join them, after preparing their vengeance in secret.

“And will not behold the majesty of the Lord”: these Caucasians will not be in the presence of the Lord, as Balaam said, I shall see him, but not now; I shall behold him, but not nigh.

“They shall see, and be ashamed for their envy at the people”: white people envy us, because God chose us and they want to be God’s chosen people.

“Yea, the fire of thine enemies shall devour them.” God’s enemies are the Europeans and the Persians, and the fire of his enemies is nuclear destruction devouring them.

precepts.why:
More fire: “Therefore, as I live, saith the Lord God, I will prepare thee unto blood, and blood shall pursue thee.” God is going to prepare Edom, the white man, unto blood, where his blood is going to be shed. The time is coming when blood will pursue America, the Israelis and the Europeans.

Why? “Sith thou hast not hated blood, even blood shall pursue thee.” Because they don’t hate blood. They love murdering and killing. You Edomite, you bloody man, you love blood, so blood is going to pursue you.

“Thus will I make mount Seir most desolate.” The Lord is going to destroy them. That is a dark sentence, a parable: it is not talking about the past, because people still live and travel there. It is talking about the future.

“Shall they not rise up suddenly that shall bite thee”: the people being oppressed, the nations, are going to rise up suddenly and bite. “And awake that shall vex thee”: those are the sleeper cells. “And thou shalt be for booties unto them.”

“Because thou hast spoiled many nations”: Venezuela, Cuba right now, Iran; Trump has bombed at least seven countries, Nigeria among them, in one year. And it is just the beginning. “All the remnant of the people shall spoil thee.”

“Because of men’s blood, and for the violence of the land”: because you love blood and war, the people you murdered, and because you are violent people. While you negotiate, they come and bomb you and kill you, family and kids and all; it was not just the Ayatollah killed, his children and his relatives were killed too. It is the department of war now, not defense: we are trying to win, we don’t care. They are trying to program machines with AI to kill humans, and the same AI company they want to use to surveil the citizens. These are the beginning of sorrows. That is the fire of God’s enemies that will devour them in Isaiah 26:11.

sense.text:
“The day of the Lord so cometh as a thief in the night.” We don’t need anyone to write to us about it: the day of the Lord is going to come as a thief in the night.

Netanyahu says they aim at military targets while the Iranian regime targets their civilians, but over a hundred and sixty young girls were killed in a strike on a school in Iran, and he said, next question. He is charged as a war criminal; his own country has charges on him. They don’t have the moral ground. The name Amalek is read as a people who lick blood.

“For when they shall say, Peace and safety”: will we be saying peace and safety? No, because they will be oppressing us; we will be going through Jacob’s trouble. When they set up some form of peace for a short time and say peace and safety, “then sudden destruction cometh upon them”: then destruction starts and the Arabs start uniting.

“As travail upon a woman with child”: when a woman is giving birth, the contractions come faster as the time gets closer until it is nonstop. “And they shall not escape.”

Trump said in 2011 that a president would start a war with Iran because he had no ability to negotiate, and now he is doing the same thing. Iran said it would rather do it the diplomatic way. Why? Because the people above him told him to bomb Iran and destroy its nuclear facilities and missiles, to set them back 10 or 15 years, because they know their time is short. They understand dark sentences.

“But ye, brethren, are not in darkness, that that day should overtake you as a thief.” The day of the Lord is not coming on us as a thief; it is coming on them as a thief. We are watching, reading the signs of the time, seeing prophecies fulfilled, so we know how close it is. It could be 10 or 20 years, but as things happen you will know how close it is. This is the time to prepare, mentally and physically.
“Ye are all the children of light, and the children of the day: we are not of the night, nor of darkness.”

“Immediately after the tribulation of those days”: the tribulation is those labor pains, the afflictions, the wars and rumors of wars, Jacob’s trouble.

“Shall the sun be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light”: the sun is darkened because of war. Remember the fires in Canada and New York two years ago when you couldn’t see the sun or the moon; with bombs dropping everywhere you won’t see the sun or the moon.

“And the stars shall fall from heaven”: that is what you are seeing on the screen right now. Those stars are intercontinental ballistic missiles. The prophets saw missiles and nuclear weapons falling from heaven; they saw Iran shooting missiles. “And the powers of the heavens shall be shaken.”

So Christ answered what to look for before he returns: first, many coming in his name saying they are anointed, his chosen people; then the abomination of desolation standing in the holy place, the land of Israel; then stars falling from heaven. When you see that, know the end is close. Don’t we see stars falling from heaven?

“And then shall appear the sign of the Son of man in heaven: and then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn, and they shall see the Son of man coming.” Christ is coming during the third woe, America being destroyed. When you see those stars falling and hitting here in Babylon, Christ is right there behind them. That is why in tribulation and anguish we are going to laugh.

This goes into the destruction of those people that call themselves Jews and are not. “They which dwell upon earth shall be taken in a great number”: that is the third woe, when billions of people are going to die.

“And the way of truth shall be hidden”: who the Israelites are, who the people of that land are, is hidden. “And the land shall be barren of faith.”
“But iniquity shall be increased above that which now thou seest, or that thou hast heard long ago.” You see how wicked this world is getting. That is prophesied.

“And the land, that thou seest now to have root, shalt thou see wasted suddenly.” The land that has root now is the land of Israel, and you are going to see it destroyed suddenly, by the Persians and the Arabs. That goes back to destruction at noonday. Wasted means nuclear bombs: God created the waster.

“Thou shalt see after the third trumpet”: in Revelation the third trumpet is nuclear war. “That the sun shall suddenly shine again in the night”: a nuclear bomb going off in the night looks like the sun shining. That is what the prophet saw. “And the moon thrice in the day”: three nuclear bombs going off in the day, as it speaks of Ekron, Ashdod and Askelon.

That is the truth of why Iran was attacked: they are trying to stop God’s prophecy, or slow it down. But his counsel shall stand. They are not going to be able to stop it. Iran is going to develop nuclear warheads, the Arabs are all going to unite, and then they are going to be brought down in the valley of Jehoshaphat.
